feeds.title: The Text Message Blog » World War II
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with World War II. As employees of the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA), we are stewards of billions of pages of records that contain historical and evidentiary information created by the Federal Government. The Text Message is an opportunity for staff members and volunteers to share their knowledge and discoveries with the public. We hope you enjoy reading about our finds as much as we enjoy sharing them with you.

feeds.title: A Mighty Girl Blog » World War II
feeds.description: Covers World War II Book reviews. A Mighty Girl is the world's largest collection of books, toys, and movies for parents, teachers, and others dedicated to raising smart, confident, and courageous girls.

feeds.title: WW2 Research Blog
feeds.description: News, blog posts and events on World war 2. Bill Beigel is a historical military casualty researcher, specializing in revealing the stories of American servicemen and women who died in active duty in World War II and the Korean and Vietnam Wars.

feeds.title: The Historic England Blog » Second World War
feeds.description: This section of our blog website features articles that have to do exclusively with the Second World War. Some sub-topics may include Historic photography, First world war, Post-war Architecture, Listed places, and more. Historic England is the public body that helps people care for, enjoy and celebrate England's spectacular historic environment.

feeds.title: WWII Veterans History Project Blog
feeds.description: Follow our journey of capturing WWII veteran stories, educating the next generation, and giving the past a future - one story at a time. The WWII Veterans History Project, Inc. is a nonprofit educational organization that strives for the historic preservation of the memories of the men and women who saved our country and the world during the Second World War.

feeds.title: World Wars View
feeds.description: Articles on Battles from World Wars 1 & 2. With a judicious blend of meticulous research and profound academic rigor, the World Wars View blog navigates the annals of history to resurrect the vivid past, offering readers a panoramic tableau of the geopolitical, sociocultural, and technological undercurrents that shaped the global landscape.
